custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) Which sentence doesn't use the positive degree?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Very few private banks are as old as AB Bank PLC.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Very few films are as impactful as "Schindler's List."
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Pubali Bank PLC is larger than any other private bank in Bangladesh.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: No other bank is as cooperative as EBL PLC.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Pubali Bank PLC is larger than any other private bank in Bangladesh.  - Comparative Degree.
 
• Positive Degree চেনার উপায়:
→ Positive Degree- তে "Very few....as...as/so....as....." অথবা "No other.....as....as...." বসে।

• Comparative Degree চেনার উপায়:
→ Comparative Degree- তে "than any other/than all other/than most other" বসে।

অপশন আলোচনা:
→ Very few private banks are as old as AB Bank PLC. - Positive Degree
→ Very few films are as impactful as "Schindler's List." - Positive Degree
→ No other bank is as cooperative as EBL PLC. - Positive Degree

Source: A Passage to the English Language, S. M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
২) Change it into simple:
It is sure that Pakistan's economic crisis will escalate, and the inflation rate will soar to unprecedented levels.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: It is surely of being Pakistan's economic crisis will escalate, and the inflation rate will soar to unprecedented levels.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: In spite of being Pakistan's economic crisis will escalate, and the inflation rate will soar to unprecedented levels.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Pakistan's economic crisis will escalate, and the inflation rate will soar to unprecedented levels for being sure.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Surely, Pakistan's economic crisis will escalate, and the inflation rate will soar to unprecedented levels.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complex Sentence: It is sure that Pakistan's economic crisis will escalate, and the inflation rate will soar to unprecedented levels.
Simple Sentence: Surely, Pakistan's economic crisis will escalate, and the inflation rate will soar to unprecedented levels.

Complex to simple: 
→ Complex sentence এ 'it is sure' থাকলে Simple sentence এ 'it is sure' এর পরিবর্তে surely হবে।
→ It is sure এর পরের relative pronoun টি বাদ যাবে, এরপরে বাকি sentence টি বসবে।

অন্য দিকে, 
→ Complex sentence এ 'it is certain' থাকলে Simple sentence এ 'it is certain' এর পরিবর্তে certainly হবে।
→ Complex sentence এ 'it is suddden' থাকলে Simple sentence এ 'it is sudden' এর পরিবর্তে suddenly হবে।
→ Complex sentence এ 'it is clear' থাকলে Simple sentence এ 'it is clear' এর পরিবর্তে clearly হবে।
→ Complex sentence এ 'it is definite' থাকলে Simple sentence এ 'it is definite' এর পরিবর্তে definitely হবে।

Example:
Complex Sentence: It is clear that the project is progressing well.
Simple Sentence: Clearly, the project is progressing well.

Complex Sentence: It was sudden that he lost his mobile.
Simple Sentence: Suddenly, he lost his mobile.

Complex Sentence: It is definite that the event will take place.
Simple Sentence: Definitely, the event will take place.

Source: A Passage to the English Language, S. M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) The central bank of Bangladesh, Bangladesh Bank, oversees monetary policies, _____________?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complete Sentence: The central bank of Bangladesh, Bangladesh Bank, oversees monetary policies, doesn't it?

→ যেহেতু, প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি affirmative এ আছে, তাই  Tag question negative  হয়েছে এবং বাক্যটি present indefinite tense হওয়ায় Subject ও Tense অনুসারে এবং verb singular ও subject টি 3rd person singular হওয়ায় Tag question এর ক্ষেত্রে doesn't it হয়েছে।

• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
→ সাধারণত Tag question ব্যবহৃত হয় পূর্বে উল্লিখিত কোন উক্তি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত হওয়ার জন্য।
→ Statement positive হলে tag question টা negative হবে।
→ আবার statement negative হলে tag question positive হবে।
→ Subject ও Tense অনুসারে, auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question তৈরি হয়।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
৪) Choose the correct comparative form of the sentence.
Very few economic indicators are as crucial as the U.S. dollar exchange rate.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: The U.S. dollar exchange rate is one of the most crucial economic indicators.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: The U.S. dollar exchange rate is as crucial than many other economic indicator.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: The U.S. dollar exchange rate is really crucial than many other economic indicators.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: The U.S. dollar exchange rate is more crucial than most other economic indicators.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Positive Degree: Very few economic indicators are as crucial as the U.S. dollar exchange rate.
Comparative Degree: The U.S. dollar exchange rate is more crucial than most other economic indicators.

Very few যুক্ত Positive Degree-কে Comparative Degree-তে পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
(1) প্রদত্ত Sentence-এর শেষের Subject-টি প্রথমে বসে +
(2) প্রদত্ত Verb বসে +
(3) Positive Degree- এর Comparative form বসে +
(4) than most other বসে +
(5) Very few-এর পর থেকে Verb-এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত বসে।

More Examples:
Positive: Very few metals are as costly as gold.
Comparative: Gold is costlier than most other metals.

Positive: Very few cities are as crowded as Tokyo.
Comparative: Tokyo is more crowded than most other cities.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
৫) "Explore the intricate historical tapestry woven by delving into the life, ideals, and leadership of Bangabandhu, while simultaneously unravelling the multifaceted layers of the nation's banking system, scrutinizing its evolution, innovations, and pivotal role in shaping the economic landscape."
This is an-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
"Explore the intricate historical tapestry woven by delving into the life, ideals, and leadership of Bangabandhu, while simultaneously unravelling the multifaceted layers of the nation's banking system, scrutinizing its evolution, innovations, and pivotal role in shaping the economic landscape." 

→ বাক্যটি Imperative Sentence.
→ বাক্যটিতে 'আদেশ' বোঝানো হয়েছে।
→ বাক্যটির subject 'you' উহ্য রয়েছে।
→ এখানে, Principal Verb হিসেবে রয়েছে: Explore.
 
Imperative Sentence:
→ যে sentence-এ কোন আদেশ (order), উপদেশ (advice), অনুরোধ (request)- প্রকাশিত হয় তাকে Imperative sentence বলে।
যেমন:
→ আদেশ বুঝাতে, Father: Karim, go home.
→ উপদেশ বুঝাতে, Doctor: Take this medicine every other day.

গঠন:
- Imperative sentence-এর বক্তব্যটি (আদেশ, অনুরোধ, উপদেশ) second person বা you কে লক্ষ্য করে বলা হয়।
- কিন্তু এই you বাক্যে উহ্য থাকে। অর্থাৎ,
⇒ Imperative sentence-এর subject হলো second person (you) যা উহ্য থাকে।
⇒ Sentence শুরু হয় principal verb দিয়ে।

- Verb-এর পরবর্তী সমস্ত অংশকে extension বলা হচ্ছে।
যেমন: (you) Do the work. 

এখানে,
- Do হচ্ছে Principal verb.
- the work হচ্ছে extension.

Source: A Passage to the English Language, S. M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) Mobile banking services have gained popularity among the population in Bangladesh, ___________?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complete Sentence: Mobile banking services have gained popularity among the population in Bangladesh, haven't they?

→ যেহেতু, প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি affirmative এ আছে, তাই  Tag question negative হয়েছে এবং বাক্যটি present perfect tense হওয়ায় Subject ও Tense অনুসারে এবং verb plural ও subject টি 3rd person plural হওয়ায় Tag question এর ক্ষেত্রে haven't they হয়েছে।

• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
→ সাধারণত Tag question ব্যবহৃত হয় পূর্বে উল্লিখিত কোন উক্তি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত হওয়ার জন্য।
→ Statement positive হলে tag question টা negative হবে।
→ আবার statement negative হলে tag question positive হবে।
→ Subject ও Tense অনুসারে, auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question তৈরি হয়।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
৭) "Though the Reserve Bank crisis in Sri Lanka garnered international attention, the government swiftly implemented comprehensive reforms to stabilize the financial situation."
This is a -
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• "Though the Reserve Bank crisis in Sri Lanka garnered international attention, the government swiftly implemented comprehensive reforms to stabilize the financial situation."
→ This is a - Complex Sentence.
→ এখানে, একটি Principal Clause এবং 'Though' যুক্ত একটি Subordinate Clause রয়েছে।

Complex Sentence:
→ যে sentence-এ একটি Principal Clause এবং এক বা একাধিক Subordinate Clause থাকে, তাকে Complex Sentence বলে।
→ Subordinate Clause এর শুরুতে সাধারণত:
if, though, although, as, because, since, so that, until, till, unless, when, why, who, which, where, how, before, after, whether, while ইত্যাদি থাকে।

যেমন,
→ Though Taher studied hard for the exam, he didn't perform well.
→ বাক্যটির Subordinate Clause- এর শুরুতে Though থাকায় বাক্যটি Complex Sentence.

More Examples of Complex Sentences:
- Although it was raining, they decided to go for a walk in the park.
- Because she had missed the bus, she had to call a cab to get to work.
- After the movie ended, we went to a nearby cafe for some coffee.
- Since they lived far away, they only visited their grandparents during the holidays.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) Identify the correct sentence.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Financial inclusion has not been a focus in the banking sector in Bangladesh, has it.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Financial inclusion has not been a focus in the banking sector in Bangladesh, haven't it?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Financial inclusion has not been a focus in the banking sector in Bangladesh, hasn' it?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Financial inclusion has not been a focus in the banking sector in Bangladesh, has it?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Correct Sentence: Financial inclusion has not been a focus in the banking sector in Bangladesh, has it?

→ যেহেতু, প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি negative এ আছে, তাই Tag question affirmative- এ হবে এবং বাক্যটি present tense হওয়ায় Subject ও Tense অনুসারে এবং verb singular ও subject টি 3rd person singular হওয়ায় Tag question এর ক্ষেত্রে has it হয়েছে।

• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
→ সাধারণত Tag question ব্যবহৃত হয় পূর্বে উল্লিখিত কোন উক্তি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত হওয়ার জন্য।
→ Statement positive হলে tag question টা negative হবে।
→ আবার statement negative হলে tag question positive হবে।
→ Subject ও Tense অনুসারে, auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question তৈরি হয়।
→ tag question এর শেষে সর্বদা question mark (?) বসে। তাই, অপশন (ক) সঠিক নয়।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) The Great Depression was a challenging period in history, let's discuss its causes and repercussions, ________?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complete Sentence: The Great Depression was a challenging period in history, let's discuss its causes and repercussions, shall we?
→ বাক্যটিতে comma (,) এর পরবর্তী clause অনুসারে tag question shall we হয়েছে।

• সাধারণত Tag question ব্যবহৃত হয় পূর্বে উল্লিখিত কোন উক্তি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত হওয়ার জন্য।
→ Statement positive হলে tag question টা negative হবে। আবার statement negative হলে tag question positive হবে।

• Tag question এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,

• Let’s বা Let us থাকলে Tag- এ shall we বসাতে হয়।
→ যেমন: Let’s play football, shall we?
→ যেহেতু, প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যের comma (,)- র পরবর্তী অংশে Let's আছে তাই শূন্যস্থানে shall we বসেছে।
→ Example: Let's have a cup of tea, shall we?

আবার,
→ Imperative Sentence হলে Tag- এ will you বসে।
→ Example: Open the door, will you?

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
১০) "May Abdur Rouf Talukder serve with wisdom and dedication as the governor of Bangladesh Bank, contributing to the economic prosperity and stability of the nation."
This is an-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
"May Abdur Rouf Talukder serve with wisdom and dedication as the governor of Bangladesh Bank, contributing to the economic prosperity and stability of the nation."

→ This is an- Optative Sentence.
→ বাক্যটি দ্বারা মনের ইচ্ছা বা কামনা, প্রার্থনা বুঝানো হয়েছে।

Optative Sentence:
→ যে বাক্য দ্বারা মনের ইচ্ছা বা কামনা, প্রার্থনা এসব বুঝায় তাকে Optative Sentence বলে।
যেমন: May you live long. 
→ বাক্যটিতে বক্তা (speaker) অন্য একজন ব্যক্তির (you-এর) দীর্ঘ জীবন কামনা করছে।
→ তাই বাক্যটি Optative Sentence.

Optative Sentence চেনার উপায়:
→ Optative Sentence-এর প্রথমে সাধারণত may-verbটি বসে। যেমন: May
→ তারপর যার জন্য কামনা করা হচ্ছে তার noun বা pronoun বসে। যেমন: May you
→ এরপরে যে কাজটি ঘটুক বলে কামনা করা হচ্ছে তা (bare infinitive; s/es/ing/ed-ছাড়া) বসবে। যেমন: May you live
→ প্রয়োজনীয় word এরপরে যুক্ত করে বাক্য কে অর্থপূর্ণ করতে হবে। যেমন: May you live long.

More Examples of Optative Sentences:
- May your journey be safe and enjoyable.
- May you find success in every step you take.
- May your days be filled with laughter and joy.
- May peace prevail in the world.

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
১১) "Formulate strategic responses to both the Ukraine war and the Europe energy crisis, else the geopolitical landscape may witness heightened tensions and uncertainties."
This is both -
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: a complex sentence and an imperative sentence.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: a compound sentence and an imperative sentence.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: a compound sentence and an optative sentence.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: a compound sentence and an exclamatory sentence.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
"Formulate strategic responses to both the Ukraine war and the Europe energy crisis, else the geopolitical landscape may witness heightened tensions and uncertainties."
→ This is both a compound sentence and an imperative sentence.
→ বাক্যটিতে দুইটি principal clause,  else- coordinating conjunction দ্বারা গঠিত। তাই, এটি compound sentence.
→ আবার, বাক্যটি Imperative Sentence.
→ বাক্যটিতে 'উপদেশ' বোঝানো হয়েছে।
→ বাক্যটির subject 'you' উহ্য রয়েছে।
→ এখানে, Principal Verb হিসেবে রয়েছে: Formulate.

Compound Sentence:
→ যে বাক্যে একাধিক Principal Clause 'Coordinating Conjunction' দ্বারা যুক্ত থাকে তাকে Compound Sentence বলে।
Compound Sentence গঠনের শর্ত হচ্ছে-
→ বাক্যে একের অধিক Principal Clause থাকবে।
→ বাক্যে এক বা একাধিক Coordinating Conjunction থাকবে।

⇒ and, or, but, both, fewer than, neither, and, not only.... but also, no less than, neither... nor, either... or, otherwise, still, yet, else, nevertheless, on the contrary, while, whereas, only, so, therefore, consequently, for- ইত্যাদি Coordinating Conjunction দ্বারা Compound Sentence গঠিত হয়।

Imperative Sentence:
→ যে sentence-এ কোন আদেশ (order), উপদেশ (advice), অনুরোধ (request)- প্রকাশিত হয় তাকে Imperative sentence বলে।
যেমন:
→ আদেশ বুঝাতে, Father: Karim, go home.
→ উপদেশ বুঝাতে, Doctor: Take this medicine every other day.

Source: A Passage to the English Language, S. M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১২) Yesterday was so much fun, ____________?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complete Sentence: Yesterday was so much fun, wasn't it?

→ যেহেতু, প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি affirmative এ আছে, তাই  Tag question negative  হয়েছে এবং বাক্যটি past indefinite tense হওয়ায় Subject ও Tense অনুসারে এবং verb singular ও subject টি 3rd person singular হওয়ায় Tag question এর ক্ষেত্রে wasn't it হয়েছে।

• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
→ সাধারণত Tag question ব্যবহৃত হয় পূর্বে উল্লিখিত কোন উক্তি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত হওয়ার জন্য।
→ Statement positive হলে tag question টা negative হবে।
→ আবার statement negative হলে tag question positive হবে।
→ Subject ও Tense অনুসারে, auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question তৈরি হয়।

Source: britishcouncil.org

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
১৩) "What an achievement he has made in such a short time, earning accolades from all around the world!"
Transform it into Assertive.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: It is a very good achievement he has made in such a short time, earning accolades from all around the world.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: It is a very great achievement he has made in such a short time, earning accolades from all around the world.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: It is more achievement he has made in such a short time, earning accolades from all around the world.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: It is a great achievement he has made in such a short time, earning accolades from all around the world.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Exclamatory Sentence: What an achievement he has made in such a short time, earning accolades from all around the world!
Assertive Sentence: It is a great achievement he has made in such a short time, earning accolades from all around the world.

Exclamatory sentence থেকে Assertive sentence রূপান্তর করার উপায়:
→ প্রথমে subject বসে + verb + a/an + very/great + adjective + বাকী অংশ।
→ 'What' থাকলে a/an বসে, 'How' থাকলে a/an বসে না।
→ প্রদত্ত Assertive Sentence- এ adjective হচ্ছে 'great' এবং এর পূর্বে 'a' বসেছে।

More Examples:
Exclamatory Sentence: What a beautiful garden it is!
Assertive Sentence: It is a very beautiful garden.

Exclamatory Sentence: How beautiful the garden is!
Assertive Sentence: The garden is very beautiful.

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) Investigate the role of innovation in enhancing competitiveness in the Bangladesh garment sector, ____________?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complete Sentence: Investigate the role of innovation in enhancing competitiveness in the Bangladesh garment sector, will you?
→ বাক্যটি imperative sentence- এ রয়েছে।
→ Imperative Sentence হওয়ায় Tag- এ will you বসেছে।

• সাধারণত Tag question ব্যবহৃত হয় পূর্বে উল্লেখিত কোন উক্তি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত হওয়ার জন্য।
→ Statement positive হলে tag question টা negative হবে। আবার statement negative হলে tag question positive হবে।

More Example:
1. Open the door, will you?
2. Choose the correct tag, will you?

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) Transform the simple sentence "In spite of the economic and oil crises worldwide caused by the Palestine-Israeli conflict, global leaders are not actively seeking solutions to stabilize the affected regions." into a complex sentence.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Although the economic and oil crises worldwide are caused by the Palestine-Israeli conflict, global leaders are not actively seeking solutions to stabilize the affected regions.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Despite of the economic and oil crises worldwide are caused by the Palestine-Israeli conflict, global leaders are not actively seeking solutions to stabilize the affected regions.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Although the economic and oil crises worldwide caused by the Palestine-Israeli conflict and global leaders are not actively seeking solutions to stabilize the affected regions.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Although the economic and oil crises worldwide caused by the Palestine-Israeli conflict and so global leaders are not actively seeking solutions to stabilize the affected regions.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Simple sentence: In spite of the economic and oil crises worldwide caused by the Palestine-Israeli conflict, global leaders are not actively seeking solutions to stabilize the affected regions.
Complex sentence: Although the economic and oil crises worldwide are caused by the Palestine-Israeli conflict, global leaders are not actively seeking solutions to stabilize the affected regions.

In spite of → Though
• In spite of যুক্ত simple sentence কে complex এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
→ In spite এর পরিবর্তে Though/Although বসে + subject বসে + verb বসে + adjective/noun বসে + comma বসে + অপর বাক্যটি বসে।

More Example:
Simple: In spite of his having riches, he leads a poor life.
Complex: Although he has riches, he leads a poor life.

Simple: In spite of his having many friends, he often feels lonely.
Complex: Although he has many friends, he often feels lonely.

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.
